result.title: SonoAtlasWorld: Anatomy-Grounded Ultrasound World Models for Wide-Range Scanning
result.comment: Interactive video demonstrations are available at: https://sonoatlasworld.github.io/SonoAtlasWorld
result.summary: Learning robotic ultrasound policies requires interactive environments for scalable data generation and repeatable evaluation, while exploration on real patients is limited by acquisition costs and safety constraints. Generative world models offer an alternative, but image history and probe actions alone do not ensure anatomical consistency across wide-range scans and changing acoustic windows. We introduce SonoAtlasWorld, an ultrasound world model built on anatomy as state. A persistent 3D anatomical asset extracted from computed tomography (CT) anchors each scan to a specific anatomy. Probe actions determine anatomical and acoustic visibility conditions for a causal ultrasound generator trained on clinical videos. Our three-stage pipeline combines anatomy-conditioned pretraining, causal conversion and long-rollout alignment. Inference optimizations achieve pose-to-ultrasound throughput of 81.2 FPS. To evaluate anatomical control beyond image similarity, we introduce the Action-Following Index (AFI), which measures normalized reconstruction gain over a static-prefix baseline. On 40 held-out 3D volumes, SonoAtlasWorld achieves liver and macro-organ AFI of 0.428 and 0.262, compared with at most 0.117 and 0.038 for the tested action- and geometry-conditioned methods. Long-rollout alignment reduces brightness drift by 3.46x at the end of 40 repeated scan cycles. SonoAtlasWorld also generates offline policy-training demonstrations and supports anatomically grounded closed-loop evaluation. Scaling the generated training data improves key-plane acquisition success from 48.2% to 81.2% on unseen anatomies in simulation, demonstrating its utility for robotic ultrasound policy learning.

AI.brief_summary: 构建以解剖为状态的超声世界模型：用 CT 提取的持久 3D 解剖资产锚定扫描，由探头动作决定解剖与声学可见性，并训练因果超声生成器；采用三阶段流程与推理优化达到 81.2 FPS，同时提出 AFI 衡量动作跟随程度。
AI.relevance_reason: 将「持久解剖资产」作为外置状态锚定生成、并以静态前缀基线归一化增益（AFI）评价动作因果贡献，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据如何进入内部状态、以及 latent 内容是否真正被使用而非退化为基线。
